resources.string: Time in media apps drains a charge. It recharges while you are away.
This is how the battery knows which app is in front.
This is how the block screen gets in front.
Without it nothing can be blocked.
The charge reading lives in a notification.
Optional. A block lands the instant an app opens instead of up to a second later.
Optional. Lets the battery see a tracked app playing sound, so listening with the screen off still counts. It never reads your notifications.
Keeps the timekeeper alive in the background.
